title: Answering all of your FAQs about planning a trip out to gander- feel ...
transcript: The number one question that I have been asked about my come from away trip to Gander is how can I book a screech in like they do in the show? So this video will tell you all you need to know about booking one, as well as some bonus gander tips at the end. Now they host screech ins all throughout Newfoundland, but for the purposes of this video I'm just going to be talking about getting screeched in in Gander. And for that you're gonna wanna go to the Legion, which is actually the place where they get screeched in in the show. It is like part bar, part community center and is actually run by the real life Buelah And if you do get screeched in here, you're likely to see her, Brian, who was part of the real life inspiration for Janice in the show, and Claude, who was the mayor of Gander featured in the show. And booking a screech in is actually shockingly easy. You can either call them on the number on their website or just email Beulah directly via the email above. Now they are not doing screech ins every single night, but if you're there for a few days, the odds of them hosting a screech in during that time is high. There are also some bus tours that will include a screech in as part of their itinerary, but most of these are longer bus tours that stop at multiple places in Newfoundland. So if you're Just interested in the gander come from away stuff. This may not be the best option. While we were there we actually ended up tagging along with a tour company called Ghostlight Global that specializes in theatre trips and was doing a Gander come from away themed bus tour. I'm not sure if they're planning on running it again, but maybe worth keeping an eye on them. And now, as promised, a few other quick gander tips! No. 1 book a car and hotel way ahead of time. There are no taxis or cabs in the city, so the only way to get around is if you have a car. And car and hotel reservations can fill up fast, so definitely recommend getting that out of the way sooner rather than later. Another tip is to go out of your way to talk to some of the locals. It is really cool meeting some of the people that are featured in the show, but literally everyone in that town has a story of what they were doing during that period. And it's really cool getting to hear some of these untold stories. And finally, definitely go see Come From Away if it is running. Their current run is running through mid September, but this is their fourth year doing this specific production and the plan is to keep bringing it back every summer. So if you're planning a trip for a future summer, definitely keep an eye out for dates!
